name: incidentflow-plus
description: SLA-based smart campus service and bus tracking system

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test:unit
scripts.test:ci: npm --prefix backend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
scripts.coverage:all: npm --prefix backend run coverage && npm --prefix frontend run coverage
